item.title: DeepSeek V4
item.description: DeepSeek V4 ships in two MIT-licensed variants — V4-Pro and V4-Flash — with weights published on Hugging Face. It’s a genuinely open model: download it, fine-tune it, or ship it in a product, not just call an API.
